mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.kakaoId, u.naverId, u.googleId, u.login_id, u.academy_id, a.name AS academy_name, u.password_hash, u.name, u.email, u.phone, u.role, u.status, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.withdrawn_at, u.school_grade FROM users u LEFT JOIN academies a ON a.academy_id = u.academy_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.user_id, u.academy_id, u.login_id, u.name, u.email, u.phone, u.role, u.status, u.kakaoId, u.naverId, u.googleId, u.school_grade, c.name AS class_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN class_students cs ON u.user_id = cs.student_id AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN classes c ON cs.class_id = c.class_id WHERE u.academy_id = #{academyId} AND u.role != 'ADMIN' ORDER BY u.user_id DESC
